item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom pathlib import Path\\nfrom work import evaluate\\nrequests=json.loads(Path('requests.json').read_text())\\npolicy=json.loads(Path('policy.json').read_text())\\nactual=[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]\\nreport=json.loads(Path('report.json').read_text())\\nassert actual==report,(actual,report)\\ncases=[({'declared':['z','a','z'],'saved':{'z':{'kind':'file','hash':'1','meta':{'b':2,'a':1}},'a':{'kind':'missing'}},'current':{'z':{'meta':{'a':1,'b':2},'hash':'1','kind':'file'}},'noise':{'changed':True}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),({'declared':['z','a','z'],'saved':{'z':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'},'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'}},'current':{'z':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'},'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'}},'irrelevant':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'}},{'ignored':['z']},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a']}),({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'h','timestamp':1}},'current':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'h','timestamp':2}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['x']})]\\nfor i,(req,pol,want) in enumerate(cases):\\n rb,pb=copy.deepcopy(req),copy.deepcopy(pol)\\n got=evaluate(req,pol)\\n assert got==want,(i,got,want)\\n assert req==rb and pol==pb\\nprint(json.dumps({'fixture_results':actual,'report_matches':True,'boundary_cases':len(cases),'status':'pass'},sort_keys=True))\"]}"}
